title: A robust approach to differentiate human monocyte-derived microglia from peripheral blood mononuclear cells
protocol: Collect 8–9 mL of human venous blood in a tube containing anti-coagulant.
Perform all future protocol steps within a tissue culture biohazard hood.
Add 15 mL of Lymphoprep into the center hole of the Sepmate-50TM tube as per the manufacturer’s instructions.
Remove bubbles by pipetting them out of the solution.
Gently mix blood to ensure a homogeneous suspension.
Dilute blood at a ratio of 1:1 with room temperature sterile PBS in a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Use PBS without Ca2+ and Mg2+ for dilution.
Pipette diluted blood sample into the Sepmate-50TM tube gently.
Centrifuge the layered blood immediately at 1,200 × g for 10 minutes at room temperature with maximum brake setting.
Dislodge PBMCs carefully from the side of the Sepmate-50TM tube using a pasture pipette if necessary.
Transfer the top layer (buffy coat) containing PBMCs into a new 50 mL tube.
Top up the 50 mL tube with room temperature sterile PBS containing 1 mM EDTA to prevent cell clumping and resuspend cells.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 minutes at room temperature (23°C) with maximum brake setting.
After centrifugation, aspirate the supernatant from the pellet.
Gently resuspend the cells in 1 mL of PBS containing 1 mM EDTA.
Remove 10 μL for a Trypan Blue exclusion using a hemocytometer or an automated cell counter.
Top up the 50 mL tube with PBS containing 1 mM EDTA and centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min at room temperature (23°C) with the brake on.
Remove the supernatant from the pellet after centrifugation.
Heat-inactivate the FBS prior to use.
Dissolve DMSO in cold FBS to ensure that the cryopreservation medium does not heat up.
Gently resuspend the PBMC pellet with 1 mL of cryopreservation medium.
Transfer the suspension to a pre-chilled cryovial labeled with the number of cells and date of freezing.
Place each cryovial containing approximately 1 × 10^7 cells or per tube of blood (9 mL) in a pre-chilled Nalgene® Mr. Frosty.
Store the cryovials in −80°C freezer for 24 h.
Transfer the vials to the vapor phase of liquid nitrogen after 24 h.
Prepare density gradient solution in a 50 mL tube.
Add 7.5 mL of room temperature Lymphoprep to the 50 mL tube.
Carefully layer diluted blood on top of the Lymphoprep using a transfer pipette.
Slowly drip the diluted blood against the side of the 50 mL tube to avoid mixing with the Lymphoprep.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 30 min at room temperature, NO BRAKE (1/10) for deceleration.
Gently transfer the buffy coat to a new 50 mL tube with a transfer pipette.
Top up the 50 mL tube with PBS containing 1 mM EDTA and centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min.
Brake can be turned on during this step.
After centrifugation, aspirate the supernatant from the pellet.
Gently resuspend the cells in 1 mL of PBS with 1 mM EDTA.
Perform a cell count by removing 10 μL for Trypan Blue exclusion using a hemocytometer or automated cell counter.
Top up 50 mL with PBS containing 1 mM EDTA and centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min.
Thaw Matrigel basement membrane matrix overnight in ice at 4°C.
Swirl the Matrigel vial to ensure homogeneity before use.
Aliquot and store Matrigel at -80°C for future use.
Keep Matrigel on the ice at all times during preparation.
Chill pipette tips in ice-cold PBS by repeated pipetting or refrigeration for 10 minutes.
Spray down the ice bucket containing Matrigel with 70% v/v ethanol.
Place the ice bucket in the tissue culture hood.
Perform all subsequent procedures within a tissue culture hood.
Resuspend Matrigel until dissolved in PBS to create the Matrigel coating solution.
Add 200 μL/cm² of the Matrigel coating solution to cover the surface area of the tissue culture plates.
Place the coated plates in a 37°C/5% CO₂ incubator overnight (16–24 hours).
Check the concentration of Matrigel basement membrane matrix before use.
Do not coat plates with undissolved Matrigel.
Aliquot and store unused Matrigel at −20°C.
Prepare pre-warmed complete RPMI medium in a water bath.
Wipe down PBMC cryovial with 70% ethanol before transferring into the tissue culture hood.
Transfer PBMC from the cryovial to a 10 mL tube.
Add drop-wise pre-warmed complete RPMI medium at a rate of 1 drop per second while swirling the sample until 4 mL.
Top up to 10 mL with pre-warmed complete RPMI medium.
Centrifuge sample at 300 × g for 5 min at room temperature (23°C).
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 1 mL of pre-warmed complete RPMI medium.
Perform a cell count by removing 10 μL for Trypan Blue exclusion using a hemocytometer or automated cell counter.
Use a 70 μm cell strainer to remove clumps if PBMCs appear clumpy.
Differentiate MDMi in a 37°C/5% CO2 incubator for 14 days, as follows:
Plate 4 × 10^5 PBMCs/cm^2 in complete RPMI medium on day 1.
Oscillate the plate gently to disperse cells homogeneously across the plate and leave it for 5 min before placing it in the incubator.
Leave the plate overnight (16–24 h) in a 37°C/5% CO2 incubator.
Remove all medium from the plate on day 2 and replace with fresh MDMi base medium containing 100 ng/mL IL-34 and 10 ng/mL GM-CSF.
Remove half the medium every 3 days (day 5, day 8, and day 11).
Replace removed medium with fresh MDMi base medium containing 2× cytokines.
Add 200 ng/mL IL-34 to the fresh MDMi base medium.
Add 20 ng/mL GM-CSF to the fresh MDMi base medium.
Differentiate MDMi for 14 days for downstream experiments.
Stain MDMi on day 14 with P2RY12 for immunocytochemistry analysis.
Prepare imaging chamber slides.
Coat 8-well chamber slides with 400 μL of 100 μg/mL Matrigel in cold PBS by incubating overnight at 37°C.
Remove Matrigel solution and rinse each chamber three times with PBS.
Plate 3 × 10^5 /400 μL PBMCs on Matrigel-coated chamber slides.
Culture PBMCs in a 37°C/5% CO2 incubator.
Change medium every third day until Day 14.
Aspirate the cell culture medium and wash cells once with PBS.
Fix cells with 400 μL of 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash coverslips three times with PBS.
Incubate cells with 400 μL of 0.3% Triton-X 100 in 2.5% BSA in PBS for 10 min at room temperature.
Replace incubation solution with 400 μL of primary antibody diluted in 2.5% BSA in PBS and incubate for 1 h at room temperature (23°C).
Wash chamber slides five times with 500 μL of PBS for 5 min each.
Replace PBS with 400 μL of secondary antibody containing 1 μg/mL Hoechst 33342 diluted in 2.5% BSA in PBS per well.
Incubate for 2 hours in the dark at room temperature (23°C).
Wash chamber slides 5 times with 500 μL of PBS per well for 5 minutes each wash.
Add 500 μL of PBS per well.
Slides can be imaged immediately or stored at 4°C for long-term storage.
